sources.title: A.I. automation could impact 300 million jobs – here ... - CNBC
sources.excerpt: Mar 28, 2023 · Goldman Sachs says generative A.I. could impact 300 million jobs —

reasoning: The claim presents as definitive fact ("will replace") a projection originating from a March 2023 Goldman Sachs report. The report estimated that generative AI "could" expose the equivalent of 300 million full-time jobs to automation. Crucially, the source study measured "exposure to automation"—meaning AI would complement or partially automate tasks within many roles—rather than predicting the total loss or complete replacement of 300 million jobs. Framing a conditional estimate of task exposure as a guaranteed, complete displacement of 300 million workers mischaracterizes the findings of the report.
